hardware: same XIAO ESP32-C6 and T94/SSD1680 panel; no voltage or OTP changes
source: independently interpolated30/45/60/120fps, source seconds10..22,12seconds,none temporal filter; see120fps-source-processing.json
warmup: prepare+four all-HOLD scans measure BUSY for prediction before playback; included in raw logs but not movie scan_count
limits: accepted_indices is source index coverage, not distinct bitmaps or optical settling. accepted_per_source_second divides by12s source duration; elapsed_active_us also includes final settling and power off. Report all windows, with a fixed middle-window comparison; no claim of optical120Hz.

motion120_fr7.interpretation: User saw heavier ghosting and little visible smoothness benefit over60fps; this is subjective display feedback, not an optical frame-rate measurement.

user_quotes: 残影好像很重和60FPS差不多
motion30_fr5.interpretation: User did not see clear ghosting reduction at30fps, but saw much lower motion fluency than60fps.

motion45_fr5.interpretation: User preferred45fps as a compromise, while still seeing ghosting; subsequently compare a longerFR4 drive with the same content cadence.

motion45_fr4.interpretation: No clear optical improvement established by lengthening the drive from about8ms to10ms; subsequently compare13.4ms separately.

motion45_fr3.interpretation: User selected a return toFR5 after13.4ms did not establish a quality advantage.
